final: WITH artist_counts AS (SELECT ArtistId, COUNT(*) AS album_count FROM Album GROUP BY ArtistId), album_total AS (SELECT SUM(album_count) AS total_count FROM artist_counts) SELECT ac.ArtistId, ac.album_count, 1.0 * ac.album_count / at.total_count AS album_share FROM artist_counts AS ac CROSS JOIN album_total AS at WHERE at.total_count IS NOT NULL ORDER BY album_share IS NULL, album_share DESC LIMIT 10
